definition: an area kept for one particular purpose
description: On a narrow town street at golden hour a woman edges a small blue hatchback into a tight kerbside gap between a white car in front and another car behind, leaning out of the open driver's window as she manoeuvres. The car settles into the gap beside the paved pavement, with shop fronts and cafe tables behind it. She then gets out, shuts the door and walks away along the pavement in the low sun.

taps.phrase: to lean out of the window
to squeeze into a tight space
